requests.title: Merchant size and recent growth trend
requests.question: How big is each merchant's business on Tidewick, and is it growing, flat, or shrinking over the last quarter?
requests.details: Tables: orders, tenants, exchange_rates. Last 90 days is placed_at from 2025-10-03 through 2025-12-31. Prior 90 days is placed_at from 2025-07-05 through 2025-10-02. Exclude cancelled orders. Order by last 90 day revenue descending, tie-break tenant_id ascending. Cap 50 rows.
